rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a being or thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Knowledge space link
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Persistent link to an encyclopedia entry in the Knowledge Space project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Description
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Synonym
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Words or expressions used in the same language that have the same or nearly the same meaning in some or all senses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Definition
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Short, but precise statement of the meaning of a word, word group, sign or a symbol.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Criteria quality type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured information on the quality type of the defined criteria for a measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Preferred ontology identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Persistent identifier of a preferred ontological term.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Interlex identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Persistent identifier for a term registered in the InterLex project.
